text:
Alex: Quick heads-up 8am check9 1227 accounts in the new vendor ratecard had the legacy_credit column with leading/trailing whitespace. looks like the parser treated those as truthy and assigned legacy credits.
Priya: Are previews already generated from that ingest?
Alex: Yes, nightly preview job ran at 02:15 and wrote preview CSVs for finance. no final invoices yet.
Lena: Parser snippet: ```legacy_credit = bool(row['legacy_credit'])``` which is wrong for quoted whitespace. will change to a strict parse.
Marta: Vendor ops: we pushed the ratecard via SFTP and our formatter put quotes around every field. we'll fix upstream, resend clean file, and include a checksum.
Ethan: Product wants accurate funnel projections before the canary tomorrow. can we stop new cohort enrollments while we sort this?
Priya: I recommend disabling enrollment job enrollments-2024-03-28 and turning off preview-email outbound until reconcilation.
Alex: I'll disable enrollments and revoke preview emails. also preparing a short notice to CS should any preview links already been shared.
Lena: Hotfix ready: ```legacy_credit = strip(field) and strip(field).lower() in ("true","1","yes")``` plus schema validation to reject rows where trimmed field == "". deploying to staging now.
billing-bot: Incident created: FIN-2287 - "ratecard: legacy_credit whitespace parse" assigned to Lena (P2). https://redwood.example/incidents/FIN-2287
Marta: Fixed file uploaded: /incoming/ratecards/ratecard_2024-03-28-fixed.csv sha256: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e. sending webhook now.
Lena: Ingest test run on staging shows 0.4% accounts previously misflagged. projected ARR delta -0.35%. detailed per-account CSV attached to FIN-2287.
Priya: Thresholds: if delta > 1% we halt canary; if between 0.25%-1% we proceed with conservative enrollment caps; if <0.25% proceed as planned.
Ethan: Product ok with conservative cap of 20% for cohort B if delta between 0.25-1%.
Alex: CS draft ready in FIN-2287 for any customers who saw previews: short note, no invoices affected, final invoice run tomorrow after ingest re-run.
Lena: Running backfill to recompute previews and cohort flags. backfill job job-9123 queued, ETA 22m.
Priya: Finance will run full reconciliation after backfill and post per-account deltas. ETA 90m.
Alex: Thanks team. keep FIN-2287 updated and tag me on any customer-facing copy. :thumbsup:
Marta: We'll update vendor contract: require CSV trim-and-validate or a signed checksum before ingest in future.
billing-bot: Backfill queued: job-9123."
